launches.title: Sixtyfour - People Intelligence Infrastructure
launches.tagline: Deploy thousands of AI agents to research any person or company.
launches.body:
👋 Hi, we're Saarth and Chris, co-founders of Sixtyfour (YC X25). 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Q0aVTtXFM4>

**The problem**

In 2025-2026 alone, Texas, Nevada, Indiana, and New Jersey all sued Discord for failing to identify predators on the platform.

Anonymous accounts on Polymarket made $2.4M with a 98% win rate on Iran war bets.

Onur Aksoy ran 19 shell companies and 25 Amazon storefronts, selling $100M in counterfeit Cisco gear that ended up on US military aircraft.

Today, teams that need to follow it (Trust & Safety, KYB, threat intel, due diligence) throw analyst teams at it. Still not trusting the answer after days or weeks of research. Not to mention it doesn't scale.

Bad actors slip through. People get harmed.

**What we built** 

The child predator's username. The scammer's banned accounts. The fraudster's shell company. 

All of them leave a trail.

Impossible to connect, but the trail was always there.

Our agents have now made it possible to follow it.

Give us one identifier (a name, email, phone number, username, or company name), and we deploy agents to recursively search the open web, dark web, social platforms, court records, and regulatory filings. Every signal is cross-referenced across thousands of sources. Every data point cited.

Companies using us today:

* Cloaked uses us to uncover highly sensitive, hidden data about people, identifying attack vectors against their users.
* TRM Labs uses us to attribute bad actors to real-world identities.
* Airwallex uses us to screen counterparties for shell companies and AML risk.
* Whatnot uses us to find qualified marketplace sellers that no platform can surface.
* Surge, Turing, and Datacurve use us to source niche domain experts for AI training data.

To name a few.

**Two ways to use it**

1. App at [app.sixtyfour.ai](http://app.sixtyfour.ai)
2. [API](https://docs.sixtyfour.ai/introduction) + [MCP](https://docs.sixtyfour.ai/developer-tools/mcp-setup) server to plug into Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your own stack

\
**The numbers**

In the next couple of weeks, we’ll publicly release our benchmark results with independent validation from one of the world’s leading data labs.

Our new deep people research system sets a new state-of-the-art, outperforming Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.20, GPT 5.4, Exa Deep Reasoning, and Parallel Ultra while running 3x faster than the closest competitor.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102050&key=user_uploads/804300/9d779b0d-a669-4606-991d-d7a595ab098e)

\
**Our ask**

Would really love Intros :) 

* Heads of Trust & Safety, 
* Fraud, AML, or KYB at marketplaces, banks, and fintechs 
* Heads of Risk and Threat Intel at cybersecurity teams 
* Heads of Talent and Recruiting at hypergrowth companies
* Companies needing people and company data enrichment solutions

\
Reach out at [saarth@sixtyfour.ai](mailto:saarth@sixtyfour.ai)

Hiding just got harder. Try it now at [app.sixtyfour.ai](http://app.sixtyfour.ai).

Saarth, Chris & the Sixtyfour team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102050&key=user_uploads/804300/b56fa1e1-efb9-4695-9e4f-d1af45d331dd)

launches.title: Sixtyfour - Bloomberg Terminal for sales
launches.tagline: We help hypergrowth companies deploy custom research agents that map their TAM and surface real-time, tailored market signals.
launches.body:
Enterprise sales teams spend 50% of their time on research that misses the mark. Here's why — and how we're fixing it.

Hey everyone! We’re Saarth & Christopher – the founders of Sixtyfour. 👋

**TL;DR**

Sixtyfour AI is the Bloomberg Terminal for sales. We work with hypergrowth companies to deploy custom research agents that map their Total Addressable Market and deliver real-time market signals, fully tailored to what matters most.

Customers like **Mercor**, **Traba**, **Hockeystack**, and **Conduit** use Sixtyfour to stay ahead of the curve.

<https://youtu.be/s45NR6diBPo>

**🧠** **The Enterprise GTM Problem**

If you’re selling into a niche or regulated market ( health systems, manufacturing, fintech, govtech, and so on), you already know: generic data platforms don’t work.

Here’s why:

**💡 “Intent signals” are too broad**

Most tools will tell you someone visited a pricing page. That’s not useful when you’re selling a $250K solution into a regional hospital network or a logistics hub in the Midwest.

**🧱 The nuance is everything**

Enterprise sellers ask real questions:

Did that manufacturing facility just expand its fleet?

Does it have two or three parking bays?

Did that nursing home file a new Medicare cost report?

Is the new VP of Ops a better entry point than the outgoing admin director?

These are the signals that drive pipeline and predict fit, and no off-the-shelf platform can give you that.

**🔍 Static filters can’t model your ICP**

Try finding “companies that just adopted Drift, expanded their marketing team by 30%, and hired a new CRO in the past 90 days” in traditional tools. Impossible. Our agents live in that world

**✨ The Sixtyfour Advantage**

We don’t sell contact lists. We build intelligence infrastructure for your GTM engine.

**📍 Custom TAMs, always current**

We work with your team to define and continuously update your market using real-world, dynamic data — regulatory filings, facility attributes, staff movements, and even track infrastructure like parking lot size.

**📡 Proprietary real-time signals**

From Medicare cost report changes to decision-maker exits to new vendor adoption — we detect what matters to your team, as it happens.

**🧠 Deployable custom ML models**

Have internal data on close rates, deal velocity, or expansion triggers? We plug it in.

We can train and deploy custom ML models to estimate buyer readiness, ICP fit, churn risk, and more, directly tailored to your pipeline data.

**🤖 Agents that think like your best rep**

Our AI agents mirror your go-to-market motion, tracking, qualifying, and notifying you at the exact right time.

**👥The Team**

We’re both repeat founders who have built and sold into complex markets.

Saarth is a UC Berkeley Data Science grad and ex-Whatnot (YC W20), Deepgram (YC W16), and Stanford researcher. He built one of the earliest conversational AI agents (Dart) and has been shipping products since he was 10.

Christopher, a Cornell dropout, led GTM at Onyx (YC W24) and built sales AI tools at Symbl. He’s a CalHacks AI winner and ex-analyst at Cornell Atkinson, with deep experience across AI, ops, and consumer tech.

We’ve lived the pain of building GTM systems by hand, and we’re building the platform we always wished existed.

**👋 Our Ask**

🏢 Know a GTM, RevOps, or sales leader at an enterprise or hypergrowth vertical SaaS company? Send them to [sixtyfour.ai](http://sixtyfour.ai) — we’d love to chat.

💬 Frustrated with generic signals and shallow filters? Let’s build something that works for your team.

Every intro, share, and shoutout means the world. Thank you — we’re just getting started.
